answer: Mechanism: rotating-salt nonce fingerprints. For each task, an agent derives nonce n = H(secret_key, task_id, salt_t), with salts cycling through shale, quill, saffron. It submits n plus a partial collision against prior task nonces. A duplicated agent reusing one secret yields identical n across salts, and cross-task collisions link its clones. Attacker cost: independent secrets require separate nonce searches and collision work per clone; reuse reveals linkage.
